page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, either self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token.
Install the token under the exact name miniflux; the runtime sends it as X-Auth-Token.
